Business (EAM) & STEM Majors Career & Internship Fair

Business (EAM) & STEM Career & Intership Fair Tuesday, September 8, 2026 | 11:00am-1:00pm Graham Conference Center | Harry & Bernice Vermeer Banquet Hall 
As of August 24 we have 22 employers attending. 

Submit your resume for review to Handshake. Create or update your LinkedIn profile. 

Visit Career Readiness & Experiential Learning site on myCentral for more resources.

Student Parking

If you brought a vehicle to campus and plan to park in one of the student lots on campus you need to have your vehicle registered. Please use this link to apply for a parking pass. https://ww2.central.edu/myCentral/Students/APP/Parking/

Meal plan changes

The last day to change your meal is Sept 2, 2026. If you would like to change your meal plan or have questions please reach out to Renae Tool, toolr@central.edu or 641-628-5656.

Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. Program fee: $2,250 (includes housing, most meals, tours, transportation, and entrance fees) *Airfare not included. 
Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu)

String Players Welcome!

Do you play violin, viola, cello, or double bass? There is an ensemble for you on campus, Scholte Strings. Scholte Strings meets each Monday evening from 7 to 8:30 p.m. This string ensemble is a delightful combination of college students, alumni, faculty, and community members. Central College credit is offered each semester. Contact conductor Kris DeWild if you'd like more information, dewildk@central.edu
